senses.gloss: f. (סְכֵי II; cmp. b. h. מַשְׂכִּית) face, stamp of a coin.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 99b:23">B. Kam. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>טעו בס׳ חדתא דההיא שעתא נפק מתותי ס׳</he> they (the experts having declared a coin cancelled) made a mistake in not noticing the new stamp (by which it was reinstated), for it just had come from the stamping process.
